brief.title: Catalogue: serve product records during a burst
brief.description: Shoppers opening a product page need three prepared product records. Serve that finite read workload while one app is unavailable; extra app workers still share one database. A product page reads several records; app headroom cannot remove the shared database work. Choose each app's cores, workers and queue. Required goals on every held-out outage cohort: deliver at least 90% of offered requests, errors at most 10%, completed-request p95 at most 6000 us (20 completions required). Fault survival uses delivered caller outcomes during the outage, not a health label. All offers are in [10000,70000) us; observe terminals through 100000 us. Hidden variants change burst shape, keys and failed app within the stated domain. Timing is assumption-only. Supported subtotal and full cost are Unknown.
exclusions: checkout, price updates and cache freshness
calibrated cloud timing and complete resident memory
supported cost subtotal and full cost

constraints.topology: fixed load balancer, two application processes and one relational DB; no cache
constraints.domain: 24..32 product-page calls; 3 recorded keys per call; 0..1000 us within-wave spacing; one app crash at 3000..6000 us for 68000..74000 us, recovery 3000..6000 us; all offers in [10000,70000) us, terminals through 100000 us. Synthetic assumptions only.

application.workloadDomain: Finite preloaded product-page API; 3 recorded keys per call
